name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

status.current: watching Sara's match with Rinna and Stella
status.condition: guilt-ridden and possessive after failing to protect Rinna in the first round

personality.summary: Cold and competent on the surface, but masochistically devoted and jealous regarding Rinna.

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Mistress whom Charlotte worships and feels she failed to protect.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Former opponent; Charlotte resents Stella's closeness to Rinna but explains combat details after Sara loses.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Akatsuki-side ally whose Fantasia Art she analyzes.

periods.summary: Charlotte accompanies Rinna to watch Sara's match. Rinna reveals Charlotte has been demanding punishment because she failed to protect her in the prior defeat, and Charlotte reacts jealously when Stella gets too close to Rinna. After Ikki beats Sara, Charlotte explains the technical reason: Sara's fake Edelweiss can reproduce power but only follows a drawn victory composition, and Ikki exploited the one-sword first-strike advantage against dual swords at the decisive instant.

key_events.summary: Provides Akatsuki-side analysis of why Ikki defeated Sara's copied Edelweiss.
